lyapunov_eq: A^T P + P A = -I,  A = df/dx|_0
c_star_meaning: largest level with Vdot<0 on {0<V<=c*}: {V<=c*} is an ROA inner estimate
grid: 601x601 over [-3,3]^2 (conservative: finer grid can only shrink c*)

validation.inside_note: fraction of sampled points INSIDE {V<=0.95 c*} that converge to 0 (want 1.0)
validation.outside_note: fraction on {V=3 c*} that diverge (>0 confirms the true ROA is bounded, as known)

honest_scope: This validates the METHOD (local Jacobian -> quadratic Lyapunov -> certified sublevel ROA) on a system with KNOWN bounded ROA. It lifts the certificate's local-linear claim to a certified NONLINEAR neighbourhood for THIS f. Applying it to the collapse certificate's own drift only needs that f specified; global guarantees still require grounding, per the certificate's North Star.
